name: tap-bucket-location
body: PROPOSED — pending user confirmation. The Homebrew tap and Scoop bucket are hosted in the source repo itself: `Formula/` holds the Homebrew formula (and its custom download strategy) and `bucket/` holds the Scoop manifest, so `brew tap really-knows-ai/ey-present <git url>` and `scoop bucket add ey-present <git url>` work with users' existing git access to the private repo. Alternative: separate `really-knows-ai/homebrew-tap` and Scoop bucket repos.
